LESSON: TIME RELATED GREETINGS AND FAREWELL

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: LISTENING AND SPEAKING
Topic 1.2: Time related greetings and farewell
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Time related greetings and farewell, part of LISTENING AND SPEAKING in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we greet people at different times of the day? 2. How do bid each other farewell at different times of the day?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Time related greetings and farewell together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
